**What type of PR is this?**
/kind cleanup
/sig scheduling

**What this PR does / why we need it**:
`pkg/scheduler/profile.Profile` is no longer necessary as a struct. All its fields are now part of the framework implementation (pkg/scheduler/framework/runtime). Then, Profile can be converted into an interface that the framework implements.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
